qa.notes: TECHNIQUE DEMO (phase2-design 5.2): structure and timing. FRACTIONAL TEMPO is the point - tempo 160 / speed 6 gives 5.625 ticks per row, so rows alternate 6 6 5 6 6 5 6 5 and evenTempo is false; the melody and the pluck counter-line are written on off-8ths (1:2, 1:10, 1:18 ...) so the alternation is audible as swing rather than as an artifact. ORDER-LIST VOCABULARY, which is what this demo exists to regression-test: B param 1 at 8:63 loops to frame 1 so the intro plays once; D param 0 at 5:59 DROPS A BEAT - frame 5 runs 60 rows and A'' hands over early, the piece's one metric surprise; D param 8 at 6:63 is the SHORTCUT - frame 7 starts at row 8, eliding its first half-bar; F param 7 at 6:0 sets SPEED 7 (6.5625 ticks per row, 137 BPM) and F param 6 at 7:8 - deliberately on the elided frame's first played row - restores speed 6, so the state at the loop seam is identical on both passes. DEVIATION FROM design 5.2, stated plainly: that section also asks for a Cxx-terminated ending variant, and Cxx is now BANNED by preset-suite 7.1's Gate-B loop-frame check, which fails any registered song carrying it. The ending variant is therefore reached by the D param 8 elision into frames 7 and 8 instead of by a halt, and Cxx appears nowhere. POLYMETER (preset-suite 9.1 recipe B at the 8th level, c=10, which is the substitute the doc prescribes above 140 BPM where a 5-row cell blurs): the triangle runs a 10-row cell whose phase is carried across five frames - entry rows 0/6/2/8/4 at frames 1/2/3/4/5 (64-row frames: entry = (-64k) mod 10) - cited 1:0 -> 5:54. It is 5 over 4 against the kit, it re-aligns exactly at frame 6 where the tempo changes, and its last attack at 5:54 lands before the dropped beat at 5:59 as the loop convention requires. TRESILLO (recipe C, 8th-level 6+6+4): the kit switches to 3+3+2 for the whole B section - kick at rows 0 and 6, snare at row 8 of every bar, cited 3:0 -> 4:46 - and back to a straight backbeat for A''. COUNTERPOINT and re-orchestration: pulse 2 CARRIES THE MELODY at frames 2 and 4 while pulse 1 drops to a slow harmony line beneath it (2:0 and 4:0) - the two frames design 5.2 asks for - and elsewhere pulse 2 plays an independent pluck counter-line on the off-8ths whose attacks never coincide with pulse 1's. Vxx duty repaints: the melody instrument is x-switchback-voice, which deliberately carries NO duty macro, because a duty macro overwrites Vxx from the next tick and would make the effect inert - V param 1 in A, V param 2 in B and in the elided frame, V param 0 in C, and V param 1 restated at 8:62 so the seam state is explicit. Non-diatonic colours: the raised third of A7 (c sharp 5 = 73) at 1:60 and 6:32, the dominant of D minor, and a NEAPOLITAN b flat II (E flat major) at 6:16, voiced e flat 5 = 75 in the lead over an e flat 2 = 39 bass. rmsRange: measured -21.48 dBFS across the two-pass render; the design's [-20,-9] window is unreachable on this engine, so the declared window is a snug band around the measurement, above the -30 floor.
